caption: The drawing depicts a simplified, front-facing figure wearing an institutional uniform comprised of a long, buttoned light blue overcoat with wide cuffs and a high standing collar. Over the coat, there is a draped, short cape in a bright red color, fastened at the upper chest with a yellow button. The coat itself features a double row of yellow buttons running vertically down the front. The figure also wears a blue military-style peaked cap that has a yellow insignia and black visor. The figure’s face is rendered with minimal detail, only outlines for the ears, eyes, nose, and mouth. In the top right corner of the drawing, there is a circular, yellow emblem containing text along the edge and a central image, with the text “EXCELSIOR N.Y.S.N.” and “NATIONAL GUARD.” In the bottom right corner, handwritten text reads: “HAROLD SMITH CITY MUSEUM 3 FLOOR.” The background is a plain, beige color, and there are no additional objects or elements depicted in the drawing.
title: Uniform
